examples: The train will depart from platform six at exactly nine o'clock.
قطار دقیقاً ساعت نه از سکوی شماره شش حرکت می‌کند.
Passengers are asked to depart the aircraft in an orderly manner, row by row.
از مسافران خواسته می‌شود به‌ترتیب و ردیف به ردیف از هواپیما خارج شوند.
She decided to depart from her usual routine and try something completely different.
او تصمیم گرفت از روال همیشگی‌اش فاصله بگیرد و چیزی کاملاً متفاوت را امتحان کند.
miniContext: To depart means to leave a place, especially at the start of a journey. Flights sometimes depart late because of bad weather or mechanical delays. The company's new strategy will depart significantly from the approach it used for the past decade.

examples: Organizers had to cancel the outdoor concert because of the heavy storm.
برگزارکنندگان مجبور شدند کنسرت فضای باز را به‌دلیل طوفان شدید لغو کنند.
You can cancel your subscription at any time without paying a penalty.
می‌توانید اشتراکتان را هر زمان بدون پرداخت جریمه لغو کنید.
The airline canceled dozens of flights due to the unexpected snowstorm.
شرکت هواپیمایی به‌دلیل کولاک غیرمنتظره، ده‌ها پرواز را لغو کرد.
miniContext: To cancel means to officially stop or call off something that was planned. Many restaurants now charge a fee if customers cancel a reservation at the last minute. The company decided to cancel the product launch after discovering a serious design flaw.

examples: Protesters carried a placard that read, 'Clean Water for Everyone.'
معترضان پوستری حمل می‌کردند که روی آن نوشته شده بود: «آب پاک برای همه».
A small placard beside the painting explained the artist's inspiration.
یک اعلان کوچک کنار تابلو، منبع الهام هنرمند را توضیح می‌داد.
Volunteers hung a placard above the entrance announcing the charity sale.
داوطلبان اعلانی بالای ورودی آویزان کردند که فروش خیریه را اعلام می‌کرد.
miniContext: A placard is a sign, often made of stiff card or board, used to display a message in public. During the march, dozens of placards called for better pay and safer working conditions. Museums often place a small placard next to each exhibit to give visitors background information.

examples: The doctor confirmed that the illness was highly contagious and advised staying home.
پزشک تأیید کرد که این بیماری بسیار واگیردار است و توصیه کرد در خانه بمانند.
Her laughter was so contagious that soon the whole room was laughing too.
خنده او آن‌قدر مسری بود که به‌زودی همه اتاق هم به خنده افتادند.
Schools often close temporarily when a contagious infection spreads among students.
مدارس اغلب به‌طور موقت تعطیل می‌شوند وقتی یک عفونت واگیردار بین دانش‌آموزان پخش می‌شود.
miniContext: Contagious describes a disease that spreads easily from one person to another, or more loosely, an emotion that spreads quickly through a group. Chickenpox is especially contagious among young children who have never had it before. The team's enthusiasm proved contagious, and soon the entire office felt motivated.

meaning: از زیر خاک بیرون آوردن؛ کشف کردن
examples: Archaeologists managed to unearth an ancient temple buried beneath the desert sand.
باستان‌شناسان توانستند یک معبد باستانی مدفون‌شده زیر شن‌های بیابان را از زیر خاک بیرون آورند.
Workers digging the new subway tunnel unearthed several old Roman coins.
کارگرانی که تونل جدید مترو را حفر می‌کردند، چند سکه رومی قدیمی را از زیر خاک بیرون آوردند.
The journalist unearthed documents that revealed the company's hidden losses.
روزنامه‌نگار اسنادی را کشف کرد که زیان‌های پنهان شرکت را آشکار می‌کرد.
miniContext: To unearth something means to dig it out of the ground or, more broadly, to discover something hidden. During the renovation, builders unearthed an old well that nobody knew existed. Investigators spent months trying to unearth the truth behind the company's missing funds.

examples: It is customary to remove your shoes before entering a traditional Japanese home.
رسم بر این است که پیش از ورود به یک خانه سنتی ژاپنی، کفش‌ها را دربیاورید.
The bride and groom followed the customary practice of exchanging rings during the ceremony.
عروس و داماد رسم مرسوم رد و بدل کردن حلقه در طول مراسم را دنبال کردند.
At this restaurant, it is customary to leave a small tip for good service.
در این رستوران، رسم بر این است که برای خدمات خوب انعام کوچکی گذاشته شود.
miniContext: Customary describes something that is done regularly because it follows tradition or common practice. In some cultures, it is customary to bring a small gift when visiting someone's home for the first time. Greeting elders with a respectful bow is customary in many parts of East Asia.

examples: Be careful not to scald yourself when you pour the boiling water into the cup.
مراقب باش هنگام ریختن آب جوش داخل فنجان خودت را با مایع داغ نسوزانی.
The chef accidentally scalded his hand while lifting the lid off the pot of soup.
آشپز تصادفاً دستش را هنگام برداشتن در قابلمه سوپ با مایع داغ سوزاند.
Steam from the kettle can scald your fingers if you hold them too close.
بخار کتری می‌تواند اگر انگشتانت را خیلی نزدیک نگه داری، آنها را بسوزاند.
miniContext: To scald means to burn skin with hot liquid or steam, which can happen quickly in a busy kitchen. Parents are often warned to test bath water before bathing a baby, since it can easily scald sensitive skin. The recipe recommends scalding the milk briefly before mixing it with the other ingredients.

examples: The bottle is made of transparent glass so customers can see the liquid inside.
این بطری از شیشه شفاف ساخته شده تا مشتریان بتوانند مایع داخل آن را ببینند.
The company promised to be more transparent about how it uses customer data.
شرکت قول داد در مورد نحوه استفاده از داده‌های مشتریان شفاف‌تر باشد.
Through the transparent curtain, we could see the shadows of people moving in the next room.
از میان پرده شفاف می‌توانستیم سایه‌های افرادی را که در اتاق بعدی حرکت می‌کردند، ببینیم.
miniContext: Transparent describes something clear enough to see through, or figuratively, something open and easy to understand. Scientists prefer transparent reporting so that other researchers can check their results. The new policy requires government agencies to be transparent about how public funds are spent.

examples: Please make sure your handwriting is legible before submitting the application form.
لطفاً قبل از ارسال فرم درخواست، مطمئن شوید دست‌خطتان خوانا است.
The old letter was barely legible after being damaged by water.
آن نامه قدیمی بعد از آسیب دیدن از آب، به‌سختی خوانا بود.
Doctors are often reminded to write prescriptions in legible print to avoid pharmacy errors.
به پزشکان اغلب یادآوری می‌شود نسخه‌ها را با خط خوانا بنویسند تا از اشتباهات داروخانه جلوگیری شود.
miniContext: Legible describes writing or print that is clear enough to be read easily. Teachers sometimes ask students to rewrite an essay if the handwriting is not legible. Even faded ink on the old map remained legible enough for historians to trace the original route.

examples: Members of the clergy gathered at the cathedral for the annual ceremony.
اعضای روحانیت در کلیسای جامع برای مراسم سالانه گرد هم آمدند.
The town's clergy organized a food drive to help families during the harsh winter.
روحانیون شهر یک کمپین جمع‌آوری غذا برای کمک به خانواده‌ها در طول زمستان سخت ترتیب دادند.
Historically, the clergy held significant political influence in many European kingdoms.
از نظر تاریخی، روحانیون در بسیاری از پادشاهی‌های اروپایی نفوذ سیاسی قابل توجهی داشتند.
miniContext: Clergy refers to religious leaders, such as priests or ministers, considered as a group. In some countries, members of the clergy still play a major role in local community decisions. The new cathedral was designed with input from both architects and the local clergy.

examples: The bank sent a reminder letter to every debtor who had missed a payment.
بانک نامه یادآوری برای هر بدهکاری که پرداختی را از دست داده بود، ارسال کرد.
As a debtor, she was required to repay the loan within five years.
او به‌عنوان یک بدهکار موظف بود وام را ظرف پنج سال بازپرداخت کند.
The court ruled in favor of the lender, ordering the debtor to pay the full amount owed.
دادگاه به نفع وام‌دهنده حکم داد و بدهکار را موظف کرد کل مبلغ بدهی را بپردازد.
miniContext: A debtor is a person or organization that owes money to someone else. In the nineteenth century, debtors who could not pay their debts were sometimes sent to prison. Credit agencies track whether a debtor pays on time, which affects their ability to borrow money in the future.

examples: Her birthday happens to coincide with the national holiday this year.
تولد او امسال اتفاقاً با یک تعطیلی ملی همزمان شده است.
The two meetings coincide, so I will have to choose which one to attend.
این دو جلسه با هم همزمان هستند، بنابراین باید انتخاب کنم در کدام شرکت کنم.
Witness accounts of the accident largely coincide, which strengthens the case against the driver.
شرح شاهدان از این تصادف تا حد زیادی منطبق است، که پرونده علیه راننده را قوی‌تر می‌کند.
miniContext: To coincide means to happen at the same time as something else, or to match closely in detail. The company's product launch was timed to coincide with the start of the holiday shopping season. It seemed too convenient that his alibi would coincide so perfectly with the time of the robbery.
